exposure: Women with more than one episode of RFM
Number of consultations for reduced fetal movement (single vs. repeated)
Women with one episode of RFM
single vs repeated consultations with complaints of RFM
outcome: Management of RFM (CTG documentation, ultrasound scan requests)
cohort: 1775 women with a non-anomalous singleton pregnancy attending the Day Assessment Unit with a primary presentation of perceived RFM after 24 weeks of gestation
finding: Implementing a new guideline for managing reduced fetal movement led to a decrease in ultrasound scan requests without compromising perinatal outcomes, although women with multiple consultations for RFM were more likely to be younger, smokers, nulliparous, have raised BMI, have a higher induction of labor rate, and have more ultrasound scans.
